label: Keep one session for each duplicated refresh-token hash
summary: Removes legacy duplicate sessions before enforcing tokenHash uniqueness

precheck.description: check for duplicated session token hashes
precheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM "public"."session"
              GROUP BY "tokenHash"
              HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
            ) AS "result"

execute.description: remove duplicate sessions while keeping the newest active session
execute.sql:
WITH ranked_sessions AS (
              SELECT
                "id",
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                  PARTITION BY "tokenHash"
                  ORDER BY "isRevoked" ASC, "updatedAt" DESC, "createdAt" DESC, "id" DESC
                ) AS row_number
              FROM "public"."session"
            )
            DELETE FROM "public"."session" AS session_to_delete
            USING ranked_sessions
            WHERE session_to_delete."id" = ranked_sessions."id"
              AND ranked_sessions.row_number > 1

postcheck.description: verify session token hashes are unique
postcheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM "public"."session"
              GROUP BY "tokenHash"
              HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
            ) AS "result"

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"
